- Gross hematuria is the *most common presenting sign* of UC (80–90% of cases);  
- Sterile pyuria occurs in ~30–50% of UTUC due to tumor-associated inflammation or secondary obstruction;  
- Recurrent UTIs may reflect *symptom misattribution* — i.e., prior episodes were actually undiagnosed low-grade hematuric episodes or irritative voiding symptoms from early tumor;
